requirement: Root and installable pure-Python core modules import without ROS2.
actual: root POP/fault and stack POP/fault/json modules imported
boundary: Importability of pure-Python helpers does not prove rclpy node launch.

requirement: Root and installable POP trackers reset to the same state.
boundary: Behavior parity checks local Python copies only, not ROS2 message transport.

requirement: Root and installable POP trackers match during normal tracking update.
boundary: Single-step parity does not replace rosbag replay.

requirement: Missing measurements drive matching GHOST-to-LOST behavior in both core copies.
boundary: Dropout sequence is deterministic unit evidence, not physical occlusion evidence.

requirement: A large moderate-confidence innovation enters DEGRADED mode instead of hard reset.
boundary: NIS thresholds are software-gate checks and are not real sensor calibration.

requirement: A high-confidence hard-gate innovation resets to the new measurement and remains TRACKING.
boundary: Hard reset behavior is an offline core invariant, not runtime recovery evidence.

requirement: POP covariance remains finite, symmetric, and positive semidefinite after smoke updates.
boundary: Matrix well-formedness is local numerical hygiene, not closed-loop safety certification.

requirement: Fault injector removes detections inside the configured dropout window.
boundary: Software dropout is not a physical sensing failure.

requirement: Fault injector delay queue withholds the first frame and releases it after the configured delay.
boundary: FIFO delay smoke test does not measure ROS2 timestamp jitter.

requirement: Fault injector can deterministically swap object identities for paired candidates.
boundary: ID-switch injection is a scripted perturbation, not a real tracker failure log.

requirement: Fault injector can append a deterministic false-positive candidate.
boundary: False-positive injection is a preflight perturbation only.

requirement: JSON payloads round-trip and normalize into finite detection dictionaries.
boundary: JSON contract tests std_msgs/String payload shape, not ROS2 QoS behavior.

requirement: JSON normalization replaces non-finite coordinates and clamps confidence to [0,1].
boundary: Input sanitation does not prove upstream detector validity.

requirement: Leader selection rejects behind/lateral candidates and returns the front in-lane leader.
boundary: This is the deterministic preflight selector, not a learned perception result.

requirement: Non-object JSON payloads are rejected by the helper contract.
actual: JSON payload must be an object
boundary: Malformed-payload rejection is local parsing evidence, not network fault coverage.

requirement: Controller proxy reduces speed in GHOST/DEGRADED and stops for LOST or unsafe headway.
source_artifacts: velocity_safety_controller_node.py behavior mirrored in offline smoke test
boundary: Controller proxy invariants are not actuator, bridge, or E-stop evidence.

requirement: Smoke test explicitly stays below ROS2 build, launch, rosbag, timing, and physical validation claims.
actual: pure-Python executable checks only; ROS2 nodes are not launched
boundary: Passing this smoke test does not prove ROS2 build/launch success, rosbag capture, real-time latency, or physical robot safety.
